title: Cadem: Kast Approval Rises to 41%, With 93% Backing 'Plan Cancerbero' and 90% Approving of Duco's Exit
detail: The 681st edition of Plaza Pública Cadem, released August 16, put President Kast's approval up 2 points to 41%. The same survey found 93% support for the 'Plan Cancerbero' prison-transfer operation (62% calling it meaningful change in penitentiary policy) and 90% agreement with Natalia Duco's removal as Sports Minister. Respondents also expressed near-unanimous rejection of personal use of government vehicles — 92% opposed using them for vacation travel and 91% for family celebrations, the norms at the center of the Duco scandal. Among other figures tested, Tomás Vodanovic and Sebastián Sichel each polled at 60% favorability, ahead of former presidents Bachelet (48%) and Boric (45%).

title: Criteria: Kast Approval Stagnant at 35%, Disapproval Climbs to 55%
detail: The Encuesta Agenda Criteria released August 16 put President Kast's approval unchanged at 35% for a third straight week, while disapproval rose to 55% (up from 52% on August 9) and 'no sabe' fell to 10%. The 20-point approval-disapproval gap marks a retreat from the 39–40% approval the government held in June. The diverging Cadem (41%, same week) and Criteria (35%) readings underscore continued volatility in Kast's standing amid the fiscal-vehicle scandal, the Plan Cancerbero security push, and lingering fallout from the megarreforma fight.
